title: fix(ui): side chat shows text instead of the working indicator while answering
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Side chat shows a plain "Answering from this session…" text line while it waits for an answer, instead of the working indicator every normal chat session uses.

## User Impact

User impact: a pending Side chat answer now shows the same working claw (or the theme's dots/brand mark) and elapsed time as the main transcript. Failure hints and Retry are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The rail now renders pending turns through the shared `renderChatWorkingIndicator` instead of its own pulsing text hint. The companion owner records when each pending turn started so the elapsed timer survives the panel remounting. The unused `chat.rail.askPending` string and its pulse animation are removed.

## Evidence

Mocked Control UI (dark theme, 1440×900), Side chat waiting on a deferred `sessions.companion.ask`.

**Before**

![Side chat pending answer shows "Answering from this session…" text](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d01eca9a-4ec3-4822-a96a-4ac02f2f5c43)

**After**

![Side chat pending answer shows the working claw and elapsed time](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dc45aa05-08cb-465a-8016-6e377836d91e)

**After, alongside a working main chat** — both panes show the same indicator:

![Main chat and Side chat both showing the working claw](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/53d8362c-cb9b-4f9f-a992-0b7762e81f5b)

- `chat-session-companion-retry.e2e.test.ts` now asserts a pending turn renders `.chat-working-indicator .chat-reading-indicator` and no text hint; it and `chat-session-companion-focus.e2e.test.ts` pass.
- `chat-session-rail.test.ts`, `chat-pane-companion-lifecycle.test.ts`, `chat-session-companion-history.test.ts`: 46 passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:ui`, oxlint on touched files, `pnpm ui:i18n:verify`, `pnpm ui:i18n:baseline` (no baseline change): clean.

Requested by @Patrick-Erichsen.
